definition: to visit a doctor
exampleSentence: I'm going to the doctor tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Ngày mai tôi đi bác sĩ.

definition: to visit a dentist
exampleSentence: I go to the dentist twice a year.
exampleTranslation: Một năm tôi đi nha sĩ hai lần.

definition: to go to a place where sick people are treated
exampleSentence: He had to go to hospital.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy phải đi bệnh viện.

definition: to measure the force of blood in your body
exampleSentence: The nurse checked my blood pressure.
exampleTranslation: Y tá đo huyết áp cho tôi.

definition: to get a paper from a doctor for medicine
exampleSentence: I got a prescription for my cough.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lấy toa thuốc để chữa ho.

definition: to have medicine put into your body with a needle
exampleSentence: She had an injection in her arm.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy tiêm một mũi ở cánh tay.

definition: to have an injection to protect you from a disease
exampleSentence: We all got vaccinated this winter.
exampleTranslation: Mùa đông này tất cả chúng tôi đều tiêm vắc-xin.

definition: to have a doctor look at your health
exampleSentence: I have a check-up every year.
exampleTranslation: Năm nào tôi cũng đi khám sức khỏe.

definition: to have a doctor cut your body to fix a problem
exampleSentence: He had an operation on his knee.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy phẫu thuật đầu gối.

definition: to have a sample of your blood checked
exampleSentence: I have a blood test tomorrow morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng mai tôi xét nghiệm máu.

definition: to feel sick
exampleSentence: I feel ill today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay tôi cảm thấy không khỏe.

definition: to become ill with the flu
exampleSentence: Half of the class caught the flu.
exampleTranslation: Một nửa lớp bị cúm.

definition: to have a pain in your stomach
exampleSentence: She has a stomach ache.
exampleTranslation: Em bé bị đau bụng.

definition: to put your body flat to rest
exampleSentence: You should lie down and rest.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nên nằm xuống nghỉ ngơi.

definition: to not get up from your bed
exampleSentence: The doctor told her to stay in bed.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ bảo cô ấy nằm nghỉ trên giường.

definition: to cover your nose and mouth with a mask
exampleSentence: Please wear a mask in the hospital.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy đeo khẩu trang trong bệnh viện.

definition: to put your hand over your mouth
exampleSentence: Cover your mouth when you cough.
exampleTranslation: Hãy che miệng khi ho.

definition: to phone for a vehicle that takes sick people to hospital
exampleSentence: Call an ambulance quickly!
exampleTranslation: Mau gọi xe cứu thương!

definition: to cover a small cut with a plaster
exampleSentence: I put on a plaster to cover the cut.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dán băng cá nhân lên vết cắt.

definition: to wrap a cut with a long piece of cloth
exampleSentence: The nurse bandaged the cut.
exampleTranslation: Y tá băng vết cắt lại.

definition: to do what the doctor tells you to do
exampleSentence: Follow the doctor's advice and rest.
exampleTranslation: Hãy làm theo lời bác sĩ và nghỉ ngơi.
